svg.text: (a) Hourly data: the value at time stamp t
sun position at the centre t − 30 min (zenith z, azimuth φ)
tp, ssrd, strd (fdir): accumulated over (t − 1 h, t]
SWtoa and terrain shading: mean over 6 sub-steps (dots)
T, q, u, v, ps, T2m…: instantaneous at t
(b) 3 h time step: sum of the hourly accumulations of the step
sun at t − 1.5 h, SWtoa over the 3 h
